Parabola | Sales Engineers | San Francisco | Full Time

We're building the AI-powered workflow automation platform that ops and finance teams at Lyft, Flexport, WHOOP, 1000+ other companies use to escape spreadsheet hell. They get messy data from PDFs, emails, Excel files, APIs... We let non-technical teams build production-grade data pipelines by typing what they want in plain English.

Automation Engineers are our Sales Engineers -- they work with customers throughout the sales cycle to define success criteria and mutual action plans for achieving value in less time than expected. They run training sessions and debug complex workflows in hands-on time.

Looking for someone who owns the customer experience and loves data automation pipelines.

https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/parabola-io/ef9beafe-fdf0-44b9-83bd... to apply!
